title: Chapter 6812: To The Bitter End

Chapter 6812: To The Bitter End

Chapter 6812: To The Bitter End

“Eight-thousand Slash!” Eagle God flapped his wings, sending the blades downward. They resembled snow-white petals, ready to slice the world.

“Ugh...” Many living beings died from the sharp waves alone.

“Lightning Tides!” She summoned waves of lightning to protect the city.

“Crackle!” The ground of the kingdom lit up with lightning, seemingly stimulated by her attack. Moreover, the citizens chanted the right mantra to offer their vitality and chaos true energy to the kingdom’s grand momentum.

“Thunder Solidarity!” A boundless power gathered above, forming an ocean of lightning.

“Clank!” A gigantic spear emerged from the ocean and floated behind her. She wielded her spear with her left hand and controlled the energy spear with her right.

“Solidarity!” The second spear contained incredible destruction, crushing the feather blades in the air.

When it struck the sky vault, it created a portal of death.

“Rebirth!” When the door opened, the portal released hope instead of death. Hope empowered the energy spear for a thrust straight at the opponent’s chest.

“Eagle Bulwark.” He had no choice but to create a barrier, buying time to escape.

The bulwark shattered but this bought him enough time to leap into another dimension.

“You’re not going anywhere.” Blaze Ancestor blocked his path and delivered a palm strike.

Eagle God swung his blade again but the power gap was insurmountable.

“Crack!” He spat out a mouthful of blood.

Thunder Emperor’s spear continued onward, forming a deadly energy bolt capable of piercing to the core.

“Pluff!” It pierced the eagle and pinned him against the ground.

The eagle couldn’t believe these two cultivators would dare to attack him. Nevertheless, he still survived due to his mighty cultivation. Destroying an emperor’s true fate was rather difficult.

“Alright, I was wrong.” He shouted in agony: “But you’re not going to kill me so easily.”

“Is that so?” Thunder Emperor had a murderous look.

“You can’t kill me fast enough. When my grandmaster comes, he’ll crush your kingdom to dust.” He said.

“You will not be there to witness it.” Blaze Ancestor’s flame engulfed him.

“Ahhh!” He tried to escape to no avail.

It was difficult for an emperor to destroy his true fate but an ancient ancestor was a different story. His body couldn’t handle the raging flames. It didn’t take long before there was nothing left of him.

No one expected Blaze Ancestor to actively participate.

“You are right.” Blaze Ancestor sighed and said: “We, children of Golden Lamp, cannot forget our principles. We cannot retreat or compromise. Otherwise, the lamp will extinguish even if we are alive. The lamp lights us and we shall light the lamp, that is what we must do.”

“Thank you for the guidance, Ancestor.” Thunder bowed.

“No, you reminded me.” Blaze shook his head before looking up: “Frenzy will return and we shall fight them. Blow the horns, we shall be as one, fight to the bitter end regardless of the incoming horde.”

“To the bitter end!” The audience shouted in unison.
